scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run build:api
scripts.build:api: if command -v mvn >/dev/null 2>&1; then mvn -q -B -f apps/api/pom.xml package; else echo 'mvn not found on PATH; skipping the API build'; fi
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run --cwd apps/web lint --max-warnings 0 && bun run typecheck && bun run build
